offlineProtection.explainerLead: During service the dashboard or kitchen screen must be on and online.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen turns off, the device loses internet or you move to another website, offline protection takes over — it either pauses ordering or turns off auto-accept, whichever you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ During service keep the dashboard or kitchen screen on and online, otherwise offline protection may take over.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection is on.

For orders to keep arriving, the screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, offline protection takes over in the mode you chose.

Check that the “Screen on” option is on on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Turn off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders will keep arriving — customers may place orders you don’t see. Turn it off only if you have a reliable connection.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to incoming orders when your device loses connection.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses connection, this stops orders arriving while you can’t see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this vehicle loses connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online ordering
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers can’t order until you are online again.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep taking orders, I confirm them manually
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is off, so customers can still order but nothing is confirmed automatically. You confirm each order when you are online again — and anything still waiting is rejected automatically after the time you chose, and the customer gets an email about it.

kitchenCapacity.desc: The largest number of items your kitchen can make at once, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s batch size still applies on top.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, set 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all selected categories, so if you want to sell at most 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, set total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains categories. Mains will still be limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave the infinity symbol if you don’t want a limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size for the menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them capacity can’t know how long items take to prepare.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: Add a vehicle in Settings › Vehicle settings to set your kitchen capacity.

settingsCopy.allowCancellation.sentence: Customers can cancel at the latest <select></select> before the pickup time
settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Auto-accept orders
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next free slot. It confirms only when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) you still have to confirm.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: “Order ready” step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens are set separately, on each device. Customers get an email every time an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still turn it on or off for a single event on its dashboard.

whereYouTrade.stepHeading: Where does your food truck trade?
whereYouTrade.stepIntro: This sets your currency, prices, time zone and phone number format. The country can’t be changed later because it is tied to your card payments.
